consequence: sandboxed (opaque) frames have no active service worker: a confined generation cannot be served by the seed's router and must be bootstrapped inline (D12 P16, B-10)
excerpt: Note: Sandboxed <{iframe}>s without the sandboxing directives, `allow-same-origin` and `allow-scripts`, result in having the [=active service worker=] value of null as their [=/origin=] is an [=opaque origin=].
